scoring_status: All items are non-scoring evidence. Only scoring_rules.json defines independently scored final conclusions.

items.statement: Evidence for Calculated B–O change on dealkylation
items.expected: Comparable neutral/dealkylated-anion models establish B–O contraction when the same donor oxygen is followed. Model composition and environment must permit this dealkylation comparison; a full-identity pair qualifies. Source crystal distances1.666 to1.624Å establish the observed direction, but merely restating that input is insufficient. Private methyl-model lengths are not an eligibility or magnitude gate.

items.statement: Evidence for Calculated response of P–O to the B-interacting oxygen
items.expected: The same physically comparable molecular pair establishes elongation of the P–O bond to the B-interacting oxygen after dealkylation, opposite to the B–O response. Actual mapped structural evidence is required. The supplied crystal1.513 to1.525Å gives the observed direction, not a mandatory molecular magnitude or methyl-model target.

items.statement: Evidence for Relative P–O bonding at the newly dealkylated site
items.expected: Mapped anionic geometry has the dealkylated P–O shorter than the B-bound P–O, while the remaining alkoxy O is not misidentified as the dealkylated site. This distinguishes redistribution of P–O bond character from uniform stretching.

items.statement: Evidence for Electronic origin of the coupled local B–O/P–O response
items.expected: Paired geometry and actual electronic evidence establish that dealkylation redistributes P–O bonding/donation within the intramolecular O→B framework. Explain why the B–O and B-bound P–O responses can occur already in the isolated molecular pair, and relate the distinct dealkylated oxygen to this redistribution. This item scores the causal local explanation, not a second award for bond-length directions or building either endpoint. Population values must retain their partition convention; equivalent density/bonding evidence is eligible. The claim does not establish the reaction mechanism. A demonstrated equivalent explanation passes; an unsupported or unresolved causal account fails this item.

items.statement: Evidence for Quantitative extent and limits of the molecular explanation of the crystals
items.expected: Compare actual model-derived B–O and B-bound P–O changes in angstrom with the supplied crystal changes, -0.042 and +0.012 angstrom. Establish which directions and magnitudes the selected model explains and delimit the remaining environmental attribution. Free methyl-model changes are larger than the crystal changes; for other valid representations judge their actual residuals instead of requiring that residual. Li coordination, substituent effects and crystal surroundings are distinct possible contributions; a specific causal allocation requires discriminating evidence. No unique solution aggregation follows from the crystal dimer or a finite structure. This is an applicability conclusion grounded in quantitative comparison, not generic caveat credit.
